Jaishankar highlights terror, food crisis, and India-China ties in US

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that terrorism from a neighboring country remains India's key concern, impacting bilateral ties, particularly in the context of US-Pakistan relations. He also warned of a potential major food crisis in the coming months due to disruptions in grain and fertilizer supplies, exacerbated by conflicts in Ukraine and Iran. Regarding India-China relations, Jaishankar indicated that ties are improving, but the border situation remains a key issue.
